n924794d002.headline: Crisis increases wage gap by years of study
n924794d002.summary: In Brazil, income for individuals with higher education is on average 5.7 times greater than for those without formal study, a gap widened by the economic crisis.
n924794d002.why: Wage disparities by education affect labor markets, consumer spending, and economic inequality, important for economic policy and investment climate.
